### Carried forward — things the next occupant should NOT rediscover

- ⛔⛔ **`mcp__github__get_job_logs` returns only the TAIL of a log** — a failing assertion mid-run is unreachable, and the dev side's egress also blocks the blob host. ⇒ ⭐ **A failing assertion can only be reproduced locally.** When handing a red back to a dev, say plainly that the middle of the log is unreadable from here, or the dev will assume the seat withheld it. ⭐ The tail still carries usable readings (`check-test-completeness`, `report-test-timings`) that narrow 「environment」 vs 「assertion」.
- ⭐⭐ **To decide whether a red is this PR's, read the BASE's same-named check first — one call, ⛔ never a guess.**
- ⚠️ **When a dev reports 「locally green」, ask which TIER it ran.** A package's unit tier is not the CI shard; the difference is the whole suspect region. ⇒ dispatch orders must require the tier **and** the test count, ⛔ not 「passed」.
- ⛔⛔⛔ **「exported from the module ≠ reaches the entry」 holds only when the entry is SELECTIVE.** A `export *` chain carries symbols through invisibly to a literal grep of module paths. ⭐ Correct instrument: grep the **built** entry `.d.ts` for the SYMBOL NAME, with a fabricated-name negative control. The source-side shortcut is usable only after `^export \*` counts **0**.
  ⛔⛔ And the control that 「10 exports ⇒ selective」 was itself the counter-evidence, scored as evidence: 8 of those 10 were `export *`. ⇒ ⭐⭐ **A control must be able to tell apart the two cases it is invoked to tell apart.**
- ⭐⭐ **`Clause-②` asks whether an in-seat contract review is OWED, ⛔ not whether the gate will go red.** Arguing the gate stays green answers a different question. 「Unsure ⇒ `yes`」, and ⛔ the same class of change cannot be graded two ways on two days.
- ⚠️ **A card can carry another lane's stale `Claim:`.** Two claims confuse a dev told to 「check the newest claim names your branch」 ⇒ post a timeline note rather than leaving it ambiguous.
- ⚠️⚠️ **Readings are corrupted by the shared checkout too, not just writes.** Line numbers written into a card or a ruling must be taken on the **dispatch base**, with the sha stated. The same read on two trees gave `:22146` and `:22353`.
- ⭐⭐ **A pin can model the combination in which the defect cannot occur, and so is green forever.** Asking what a pin covers really means: **can its fixture even express the combination that fails?** Coverage numbers cannot answer it.
- ⛔⛔ **`stripComments` blanks rather than deletes, so comparing its output's BYTE LENGTH compares comment sizes, ⛔ not code.** Correct instrument = the ordered sequence of non-empty lines after whitespace stripping. ⚠️ A false red is as bad an instrument failure as a false green.
- ⭐⭐ **To judge whether a dev loosened a test to fit a defect, read the half it did NOT touch** — the sibling case that should be byte-identical, with the comparator fired as its own control.
- ⚠️⚠️ **`vitest run --project X <file-not-in-X>` reports a passing file, runs zero cases, and silently subtracts it from the file count** (`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts:506`/`:611` — both projects use exact-path include lists, so a command-line path intersects to empty). Filed as **#17853**.

- ⚠️⚠️ **SKILL.md:99 is easiest to breach on the ROUTINE writes.** This seat wrote a landing reconciliation in Chinese and had to re-issue it in English (#18408, comment `5716998788`; the correction is kept visible in the body rather than erased). ⭐ The four Chinese channels are maintainer quick-read, round report, ruling quotations and four-axis analysis — **a landing note, an ACCEPT, a claim, a provenance comment and a contract review are none of them.** The pull toward Chinese is strongest exactly on the bookkeeping writes, because they feel internal to the seat. ⛔ They are not.
- ⭐ **The attribution-footer appender is IDEMPOTENT on the issue-comment path, measured three ways today.** Sent WITH the bare footer ⇒ stored with exactly one (read-back class `mutated`; the only difference is one inserted blank line). Sent WITHOUT one ⇒ exactly one (class `footer-appended`). A `PATCH` to an existing comment body ⇒ the same. And `POST /issues` synthesises one at **+58 bytes**, matching `platform-readings.md:410` exactly (re-measured on #18699). ⇒ ⛔ The #18622 double-footer trap does **not** reach issue comments; it is the PR-BODY path, where the form is what matters.
- ⭐⭐ **Re-derive a line number when the file changed, even for a QUOTE.** Filing #18699 this seat was about to cite `os-dev.md:287/:299` from the stale checkout; the file had moved and `origin/main` reads `:288/:300`. ⇒ A verbatim quotation is still a reading, and it is taken at the ref you name, ⛔ not at the one you happen to be standing on.

## 4. Notes — lane disciplines that are current

*(Section 4 is carried forward from R3/R1 and is preserved verbatim except where a later measurement corrected it.)*

### Measurement

- ⭐⭐ **A control that FAILS to fire voids the reading.** R3 needed **three** attempts before one fired on a skip/quarantine sweep; the first two returned 0 themselves and would each have let a 「0 added」 claim stand on no evidence.
- ⭐⭐ **A number produced by a bad parse is not a reading, and printing it does not make it one.** Use `git show -s --format='%p' <sha> | wc -w` for parent counts — `%H %P %s` plus awk miscounts, because the parent list and the subject both contain spaces.
- ⭐⭐ **A number must name its population.** A changeset's `388` was correct — matching **lines** under `driver-sql/src/`. Because it never said so, three readers computed three different correct numbers.
- ⭐ **`$?` after a pipe is the pipe's LAST stage.** Redirect to a file instead. (⛔ `post-stamped` / `label-write` must never be piped: a refusal reads as 0.)
- ⭐ Exit code **3 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET** — nothing was measured. ⛔ Never a pass.

### Reading CI

- ⭐⭐ **Judge a red by the whole run's `conclusion` plus a per-head tree comparison. ⛔ Never the check NAME** — the name misleads in *both* directions (`Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` runs the whole driver-sql suite; `OS_EXPECT_LIVE_DIALECT_MATRIX=1` turns a missing server into a red rather than a skip).
- ⭐⭐ **Read CI as the LATEST run per check name.** A `check-runs` listing returns **every** historical run, so counting raw conclusions over-reports red. Group by name, take max `started_at`, then judge.
- ⭐⭐ **Directory byte-identity proves nothing across a workspace edge** — a fixture imported from another package trips the door while the PR's own directory is byte-identical to base.
- ⭐⭐ **PR-side CI runs the affected subset; the merge queue runs the FULL suite.** ⛔ Green PR CI is not evidence a class is clean. ⚠️ A merge-queue failure can be a semantic collision the queue itself created — fix it in the PR being landed.

### Census discipline

- ⭐⭐ **A census that misses a whole class usually has a wrong PREDICATE, not a lazy author.** ⛔ Ask which doors a zero covered before believing it.
- ⭐ **A card's own body under-counts the fix surface, and so does the seat's own sweep.** ⛔ Never hand a hand-rolled half-census to a dev as authoritative.
- ⭐⭐ **A discovered error triggers a sweep of its own CLASS.**
- ⭐⭐ **Read the newest state TRANSITION, not the newest MENTION of a blocker.** A replaced blocker and a discharged one look identical in a thread.

### Filing

- ⭐ **A pin that can turn itself red is its own carrier** — that is a reason to decline to file, and it has been measured right.
- ⭐⭐ **An Execution paragraph is authoritative about INTENT, ⛔ not immune to being wrong** (#15989: following it literally would have destroyed data).
- ⛔ **Never let a dev take the cheap ADR-0087 disposition unmeasured.**

### Channel readings — ⛔ one call each, not rules

- `DELETE /issues/{n}/assignees` answers **415** without `Content-Type: application/json`. Looks like permissions. Is not.
- `enable_pr_auto_merge`'s echo, the REST `auto_merge.merge_method` field and the webhook **all three** report `merge` for a squash landing — the repo sets `allow_merge_commit=False` / `allow_squash_merge=True`, so that value names a method this repo **forbids**. ⛔ The parent count remains the only instrument.
- ⭐ **`auto_merge` reads OFF once the queue takes ownership** — the expected post-enqueue state, ⛔ not a failed arm. Verify queue membership by the **TIMELINE**.
- ⭐ **Queue-branch absence cannot disprove enqueue** (`max_entries_to_build` truncates). The discriminator is whether the queue as a whole moved.
- **GH006**: a branch in a merge queue **cannot be pushed to**. A dev finding a newer `main` mid-run must leave the merge unpushed rather than dequeue.
- **Queue timing, 6 landings**: enqueue lag 30 s–3 min; enqueue → merge 25m04s / 25m10s / 25m35s / 29m17s / 27m10s.
- ⭐⭐ **The `Clause-②` line must be in the PR BODY, at column 0.** `Check Changeset` reads it there and **never** reads the claim comment. ⭐ The gate re-reads on the `edited` event, so a body edit clears the red with no push and no re-run.
- ⭐⭐ **A REST `PATCH` to a PR body appends the platform's own footer; `POST` (create) does NOT.** The hazard is the **edit** verb specifically — strip every footer from the body you send, then read back.
- ⭐ **A PR-body edit re-runs only `Check Changeset`**, ⛔ not the pipeline — but it also flips **`Auto Label`** and **`Check PR Size`** to `skipped`, which is ⛔ not a regression.
- ⭐⭐ **A CI gate can be driven LOCALLY before pushing** (a synthesised event payload + the real PR body). Ask for this shape whenever a gate script is the thing that went red.
- The docs-drift bot's **emitter-vs-inputs blind spot** fired repeatedly. ⛔ A green drift check is not a clean bill of health.

### Dispatch discipline

- ⭐⭐ **`premise_still_valid: false` + `pr: null` is a legitimate terminal report** — it happened twice in R1 and both were correct. ⛔ Never re-file as a rework, never count as a failed dispatch.
- ⭐⭐ **Zone-2 assumptions must be labelled as readings vs. measurements, and devs must be ordered to refute them.** ⛔ An unlabelled assumption is indistinguishable from a fence.
- ⭐ **A lane inventory taken at the START of a shift is not the lane at the END of one.** R3 reported 0 dispatchable while triage graded ~18 cards into the lane during its shift.
- ⭐ **Several lane cards anchor on packages belonging to OTHER lanes**, and a token inside a symbol name is the usual cause (`ObjectQLStrategy` lives in `packages/services/service-analytics`; `packages/runtime` is `domain:cli`). ⛔ Re-measure the definition site before claiming — 「never guess the domain from the title's vocabulary」 extends to class names.
- ⚠️ **Stale facts written into a standing instruction recur every hour and look like compliance.** ⛔ 「it's about to be disabled anyway」 is not a reason to leave one.
